And Spider-Man discovers that with great power… comes something monstrous.

New trailer concept for CRYSTAL LAKE, the upcoming A24 Peacock horror series prequel to the Friday the 13th horror movie franchise. This Crystal Lake trailer mixes clips of Pamela and Jason Voorhees from the official Crystal Lake series trailer and Friday the 13th horror shorts. Crystal Lake Series Trailer Breakdown:

0:00 Camp Crystal Lake Opens Again 
0:19 Jason Voorhees Drowns
0:30 Friday the 13th Birthday

1:12 Mommy's Here
1:34 Crystal Lake 2026 Trailer Recap

──────────────────

"The legend begins... with Pam."

A new Crystal Lake trailer has dropped to remind you that the original Friday the 13th killer wasn't Jason Voorhees. It was his mother, Pamela Voorhees. 

A24's highly anticipated Crystal Lake TV show is making a major stop at New York Comic Con before its official debut on Peacock and HBO Max. The studio has confirmed that the Crystal Lake premiere episode will receive an exclusive first-look screening at the Empire Stage at the Javits Center in New York City.

Following the screening, attendees will be treated to a panel discussion featuring series creator Brad Caleb Kane (IT Welcome to Derry) and several members of the cast, including Linda Cardellini (Pamela), William Catlett, Devin Kessler, Cameron Scoggins (Officer Dorf), Gwendolyn Sundstrom (Claudette), and Callum Vinson (Jason). 

This early screening offers a unique opportunity for fans to see how the production expands the mythology of the Friday the 13th franchise. By showcasing the episode at a major event like New York Comic Con, the creative team is signaling confidence in the Crystal Lake series as it prepares for its wider streaming release.

Serving as a Friday the 13th prequel series to the 1980 horror movie classic, Crystal Lake trailer focuses on the life of Pamela Voorhees before she became the iconic killer. Linda Cardellini stars as Pamela, portraying a single mother struggling with grief nearly a year after the tragic drowning of her young son, Jason Voorhees. The narrative kicks off when two strangers arrive at her home to investigate her past, triggering a disturbing chain of events.

While the premise leans into psychological drama and conspiracy thriller elements, creator Kane has assured fans that the horror series will eventually embrace the bloody horror associated with the iconic horror movie franchise. He has teased that the series will feature numerous connections to the original films, including various Viernes 13 Easter eggs and recreations of familiar elements that long-time Friday the 13th fans will recognize.

The Camp Crystal Lake horror series has seen significant changes since it was first ordered by Peacock in 2022. While Bryan Fuller was initially attached as the writer and show runner, he departed the A24 project in 2024, leading to Kane taking over creative duties. Despite these behind-the-scenes shifts, the crystal lake show has already secured distribution with HBO Max for Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the UK, and Ireland.

All eight episodes of Crystal Lake premiere on Peacock October 15, 2026 and internationally on HBO Max by year's end.

Linda Cardellini stars as Pamela, portraying a single mother struggling with grief nearly a year after the tragic drowning of her young son, Jason Voorhees. The narrative kicks off when two strangers arrive at her home to investigate her past, triggering a disturbing chain of events.

While the premise leans into psychological drama and conspiracy thriller elements, creator Kane has assured fans that the horror series will eventually embrace the bloody horror associated with the iconic horror movie franchise. He has teased that the series will feature numerous connections to the original films, including various Viernes 13 Easter eggs and recreations of familiar elements that long-time Friday the 13th fans will recognize.

The Camp Crystal Lake horror series has seen significant changes since it was first ordered by Peacock in 2022. While Bryan Fuller was initially attached as the writer and show runner, he departed the A24 project in 2024, leading to Kane taking over creative duties. Despite these behind-the-scenes shifts, the crystal lake show has already secured distribution with HBO Max for Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the UK, and Ireland.

All eight episodes of Crystal Lake premiere on Peacock October 15, 2026 and internationally on HBO Max by year's end.

Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Surviving Minecraft's Best Horror Mod
snippet.description:
Today I'm diving deep into The Broken Script, one of the strangest and most unsettling Minecraft horror mods I've ever played. What starts as a normal Minecraft survival world slowly turns into a corrupted Minecraft ARG filled with creepy entities, random events, impossible structures, hidden dimensions, glitches, world corruption, and things that feel like they absolutely should not be happening in Minecraft.

I played a ridiculous amount of The Broken Script to see just how far this mod goes. Unlike most Minecraft horror mods, The Broken Script is extremely unpredictable. Strange entities can appear in the distance, structures can suddenly generate around you, the world can change without warning, and the game itself can begin behaving like something is wrong with it.

If you like Minecraft horror, scary Minecraft mods, Minecraft ARGs,  cursed Minecraft, survival horror, mysterious entities, analog horror, liminal Minecraft, or heavily modded Minecraft, this is one of the wildest mods I've played.

snippet.title: FEAR FACTORY - Roboticist (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
snippet.description:
Industrial metal pioneers @fearfactorymusic launches a bold new era with "Roboticist," — the latest single marks the recording debut of the band's current lineup featuring vocalist Milo Silvestro, drummer Pete Webber, and bassist Tony Campos. Blending crushing mechanical aggression with a haunting, melodic hook, the track explores a dystopian reality where flesh fails and only consciousness endures.

"The future isn’t coming. It’s already here, ‘Roboticist’ is the next evolution of Fear Factory.
Man, Machine and the war for what comes next. I can’t wait for everyone to hear the beginning of a new era of Fear Factory."
Dino Cazares

Produced, engineered, mixed, and mastered by Damien Rainaud, the single arrives alongside a cinematic music video directed by Vincente Cordero and produced by Arion Csihar. System activated: the next chapter of FEAR FACTORY has officially begun.

snippet.description:
My FINAL fnaf world challenge... because surely I can move onto FNAF WORLD 2 SOON!!!!

Mannat's Spiff nuzlocke series:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFwE97tIZSWs&si=EdHt1NVTFgPG9LJ0

FNAF WORLD NUZLOCKE RULES:
Character dies, it's gone
GAME OVER = full reset
ONLY ONE NEW CHARACTER PER ZONE, THE FIRST ENCOUNTER. If you run from it you lose it. (marked on map, 15 total)
WHEN ENTERING NEW AREA, MUST WIN FIRST FIGHT before you're allowed to run (to make rolling characters bearable) the exception to this is the flipside, which you can run in IMMEDIATELY
All chips and bytes allowed (including auto gift)
NO giftbox MOVE (can use a character with the move, just no clicking it)
Can only roll Halloween Character after getting KEY, must be random, you can do minigame or FILES it in
MAX LEVEL: 50
Prize ball/Mystery box allowed, even if giftbox roll
